title: OGC SensorThings API — Core Model
description: OGC SensorThings API core data model, as implemented by the Fraunhofer IOSB FROST Server. Pure $defs container — the DataStructure grouping the nine entities below; it carries no shape of its own and is not itself stored as an Element.

Thing.title: Thing
Thing.description: OGC SensorThings API — a Thing is an object of the physical or information world capable of being identified and integrated into communication networks.

properties.description: Free-form key/value properties of the Thing.

Locations.description: Association to the Locations of this Thing.

HistoricalLocations.description: Association to the time history of this Thing's Locations.

Datastreams.description: Association to the Datastreams produced by this Thing.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: OGC SensorThings API — the location of a Thing, typically a GeoJSON geometry.

Things.description: Association to the Things at this Location.

HistoricalLocations.description: Association to the HistoricalLocations recorded at this Location.

HistoricalLocation.title: HistoricalLocation
HistoricalLocation.description: OGC SensorThings API — the time history of a Thing's Locations.

time.description: Time when the Thing was at the Locations.

Thing.description: Association to the Thing this history entry belongs to.

Locations.description: Association to the Locations the Thing was at. One HistoricalLocation SHALL have one or many Locations.

Datastream.title: Datastream
Datastream.description: OGC SensorThings API — a Datastream groups Observations measuring the same ObservedProperty with the same Sensor.

observationType.description: OM observation type URI, e.g. OM_Measurement.

unitOfMeasurement.description: Composition — the unit of measurement is a value object with no independent identity, always embedded.

observedArea.description: GeoJSON Polygon spatial bounding box of all Observations' FeaturesOfInterest.

phenomenonTime.description: ISO 8601 time interval covered by the Observations.

resultTime.description: ISO 8601 time interval of the result generation.

Thing.description: Association to the Thing this Datastream belongs to.

Sensor.description: Association to the Sensor producing this Datastream's Observations.

ObservedProperty.description: Association to the phenomenon measured by this Datastream.

Sensor.title: Sensor
Sensor.description: OGC SensorThings API — a Sensor is an instrument that observes a property or phenomenon.

encodingType.description: MIME type of the metadata, e.g. 'application/pdf' or 'text/html'.

metadata.description: Detailed description / data sheet of the sensor.

Datastreams.description: Association to the Datastreams produced by this Sensor.

ObservedProperty.title: ObservedProperty
ObservedProperty.description: OGC SensorThings API — the phenomenon of an Observation (e.g. air temperature).

definition.description: URI to the property definition (e.g. a vocabulary entry).

Datastreams.description: Association to the Datastreams measuring this phenomenon.

Observation.title: Observation
Observation.description: OGC SensorThings API — an Observation is the act of measuring the value of a property of a FeatureOfInterest.

phenomenonTime.description: Time instant or interval when the Observation happened (ISO 8601).

result.description: The estimated value of the ObservedProperty. Any JSON type (number, string, boolean, object, array).

resultTime.description: Time the result was generated (ISO 8601), may be null.

resultQuality.description: Optional DQ_Element describing the quality of the result.

validTime.description: ISO 8601 interval during which the result is valid.

parameters.description: Key/value pairs of environmental conditions during measurement.

Datastream.description: Association to the Datastream this Observation belongs to.

FeatureOfInterest.description: Association to the feature this Observation was made on.

FeatureOfInterest.title: FeatureOfInterest
FeatureOfInterest.description: OGC SensorThings API — the feature whose property is observed (e.g. the geographic point sampled).

feature.description: GeoJSON geometry of the feature of interest.

Observations.description: Association to the Observations made on this feature.

UnitOfMeasurement.title: UnitOfMeasurement
UnitOfMeasurement.description: OGC SensorThings API — unit of measurement of a Datastream (UCUM). A composition value object with no independent identity — it has no own STA endpoint and is always embedded in its owning Datastream.

name.description: Full name of the unit, e.g. 'degree Celsius'.

definition.description: URI to the unit definition, e.g. a UCUM entry.
